- **Interactive graph data.** When the host can see it, the snapshot also carries the member graph:
  structural Lead edges plus aggregated message edges from bounded member-session (live deliveries) and
  Lead-session (legacy records) scans. The panel remains read-only either way.
- **Multiple teams and projects.** One workspace card per live team in the grid, filtered by project
  when a project is selected.
- **Honest states.** A loading skeleton on first load, an error card with retry, a "showing the last
  successful snapshot" hint after a failed poll, an unsupported-service notice, and an empty state.
- **Bilingual.** All visible copy goes through the DSH client locale service, with Chinese and
  English dictionaries kept in sync; the panel follows the host language.
- **Theme-native.** Colors, borders, and pixel-art/graph art come only from `--dsw-*` theme tokens, so
  the panel follows dark and light themes. Graph nodes and cards are keyboard accessible and every
  animation (including the hand-off dash flow) is disabled under reduced motion.
- **Polling.** The panel refreshes a same-origin JSON snapshot every 2 seconds while it is mounted and
  the tab is visible, pauses while the tab is hidden, and offers a manual refresh button.
- **Optional navigation.** When the host exposes `uiWorkspace.openSession`, clicking a graph node
  opens that member's session. When it does not, the panel stays a read-only page.

## Requirements and compatibility

- **DSH Web UI** in the desktop app or a Web profile. The plugin was developed and tested against DSH
  `0.2.1-rc.2`; `package.json` declares `engines.dsh` as `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`, which also excludes
  0.3.0 prereleases.
- **The official experimental Agent Teams bundle must be mounted in the same profile.** This plugin
  visualizes teams that already exist; it does not provide the Agent Teams service itself. Without
  that service the panel shows a clear "not mounted" notice instead of failing.
- **Optional session projections.** Rounds, token usage, and working / idle times come from the stock
  DSH `sessionStats` and `tokenUsage` projections. They are optional: without them the panel still
  renders the graph and shows dashes for statistics.
- **A Web-capable profile.** The install examples below use the `desktop` profile; replace `desktop`
  with your own Web profile name (`web`, and so on) if it differs.
- **No separate Node.js installation is needed to use the plugin.** Node.js 22.19 or newer is only
  needed to run the tests in this repository.

## Install

The examples below use `dsh plugin --profile desktop add <spec>`. Replace `desktop` with your profile
name if you use a different Web profile.

### From the app Plugins page

1. Open **Plugins** in the DSH desktop app.
2. Choose **Add plugin**.
3. Paste `github:kkomia/dsh-agent-team-console` (or `dsh-agent-team-console` once the package is
   published

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex — native subagent progress, in-host worker sessions with per-tier presets, and a multimodal bridge that lends the text-only harness vision and image generation.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Crew

A DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok, without giving up the host's native subagent UI.
Native Progress UI • Tier Policy & Escalation • Dispatch Guardrails • Jobs Board • In-Host DSH Sessions • Vision & Image Gen (Native-First) • One-Click Install

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-crew · Current plugin release: 0.1.0-rc.11 · Tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.1

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The DSH Crew settings page — host integrations, dispatch policy, execution and the multimodal bridge

## Why DSH Crew DSH Crew is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) — an open-source agent harness. It makes DSH agents dispatchable from Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok: the orchestrator keeps its own model, the work runs on a real DSH agent with that harness's tools, sandbox, presets and session history, and the host still shows it as a native subagent with live progress. What runs the work is a DSH agent, not a bare model call. Tiers (`flash` / `pro`) select how much capability that agent gets from the harness's configured roster — DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro today — so a change of model in DSH needs no change here.
### 🧵 Native Progress UI Workers appear as regular subagents in Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok — dispatch count, running step, tool calls and token usage all show up in the host's own task panel, plus a claude-hud statusline segment: `⚙dsh 1▶pro 2m14s 21.7k/606 ✓3`. ### 🎚️ Tier Policy and Escalation `flash` for mechanical work, `pro` for reasoning, `effort` from `off` to `max`. `tier_policy` can clamp every dispatch to one tier at the tool layer, and `escalate_on_failure` retries a failed flash run once on pro — based on evidence, not on guessing difficulty up front.
### 🏛️ In-Host DSH Sessions With the bundle installed in a DSH profile, each worker is a first-class DSH session: visible in the Web UI, grouped by working directory, mounted with the Agent preset you choose per tier. Without DSH running, dispatch falls back to a standalone DSH runtime, so CI and headless environments still work. ### 👁️ Vision and Image Generation DSH's models are text-only. `describe_image` now prefers DeepSeek's own VL model (`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) whenever a key is available, then falls back to the CLIs you already have — Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity — or any OpenAI-compatible API you configure. `generate_image` borrows the same CLIs' brush. Pasted images stay visible in the conversation and reach the model as text.
### 🛡️ Dispatch Guardrails Every dispatch is checked before anything spawns. Worker→worker nesting is capped at origin-chain depth 3 and cycles are refused; a second worker on a workspace another job already holds is refused with the holder's info — never silently queued. Refusals are readable errors: wait or re-scope, don't bypass. ### 📋 Jobs Board The DSH Crew panel doubles as a jobs board: every worker job — running or finished — is listed with tier, effort, live progress and tokens, held workspaces show their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (e.g. a hub restart) is surfaced as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.
### 🔌 Custom Providers Bring your own endpoint (Base URL + API key + models) or a local command template. Each provider has a connectivity test that checks reachability and auth, then makes one real vision call so you find out now, not mid-task. ### 📦 One-Click Install The settings page installs and updates the Claude Code plugin, the Codex role files and the Antigravity / Grok agents, skills and commands for you — marketplace registration, permission allowlist, HUD wiring, absolute paths rendered for this machine — and restores them just as easily. Every settings file is backed up first.
## How it works ``` Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok (orchestrator, keeps its own model) └─ ds-flash / ds-pro ← native subagent shell (progress shows in the host's task UI) └─ MCP: dsh_run_worker(tier, effort, cwd, worker=) ├─ worker="agy"/"grok" → that external CLI runs the task (explicit opt-in) ├─ hub reachable → session inside DSH (visible in the Web UI, grouped by cwd) └─ otherwise → dsh-jsonrpc-agent runtime (worker.cordis.yml) └─ DeepSeek V4 Flash / Pro (DSH SDK, event stream → progress and token stats) ``` ## One run, two views Dispatch fans out. Below, eighteen workers translate this README in parallel: the host counts them as its own subagents, while the harness runs them as real sessions.

Claude Code sees dsh-crew workers as native subagents, with a statusline segment tracking running tiers, elapsed time and tokens.

The DSH Crew panel sees the same run from the harness side: which host dispatched each job, its tier and effort, live progress and token usage.

The panel is also the jobs board: running and finished jobs stay listed with tier, progress and tokens, held workspaces name their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (a hub restart) surfaces as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.

## Install Install into a DSH profile from npm: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-crew@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-crew dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately. ### Configure DeepSeek credentials (standalone only) In hub mode — the installation above — workers run inside the DSH instance and use the DeepSeek credentials it is already configured with. Nothing else to set up. Only the standalone fallback needs a key of its own: dispatching from a host with no DSH instance running launches a worker runtime as a separate process. Obtain an API key from [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com) and write it to `~/.config/dsh-crew/.env`: ``` DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... ``` ### Verify ```bash node scripts/smoke.mjs ``` The smoke test dispatches one cheap job through whichever path is available — the hub when a DSH instance is running, s

# dsh-image-pin-comment · 图片图钉标注 给 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的图片预览加一层**图钉 + 评论**：在图上点一下钉一颗编号图钉， 图钉下方弹出评论框写一句话；点「插入到输入框」后，**原图 + 一段带坐标的说明**一起进草稿， 回车即发。 **发出去的是原图**，图钉只存在于屏幕上 —— 模型看到干净的图，靠文字里的坐标精确定位。 ![预览](docs/preview.png) ## 它解决什么 > 「把这个按钮往左挪 8px。」—— 模型问：哪个按钮？ > 「这里文字重叠了。」—— 模型开始认真猜「这里」是哪里。 图片进入模型后只剩像素。本插件把「这里」变成模型能直接算的东西：**图像编号 + 百分比 + 原图像素 + 容差 + 建议裁切框**。 一次可以标记多张图，每张图独立编号： ```text 这两个地方怎么改？ 【图片标注】图像 1（1200×800）锚点 2 处，已在输入框中。锚点不画在图上，按下面的坐标定位：百分比 = 锚点占图片宽高的比例，px = 原图像素坐标，裁切 = 以锚点为中心的方形区域（x0,y0,x1,y1）。 1. (x: 30.0%, y: 40.0% | px 360,320 | ±13px | 裁切 321,281,399,359) 这个按钮往左挪 8px 2. (x: 70.0%, y: 65.0% | px 840,520 | ±13px | 裁切 801,481,879,559) 这里文字重叠了 【图片标注】图像 2（900×600）锚点 1 处，已在输入框中。… 1. (x: 50.0%, y: 50.0% | px 450,300 | ±10px | 裁切 420,270,480,330) 这张图的标题要加粗 ``` ## 流程（两次回车） | 步骤 | 你做什么 | 插件做什么 | | --- | --- | --- | | 1 | 点开会话里的任意图片（消息里的截图、输入框草稿图、工具返回的图） | 预览底部出现工具条：`标注 · 0 处 · 清空 · 插入到输入框` | | 2 | 点「标注」 | 进入图钉模式，光标变十字 | | 3 | 在图上任意位置左键点一下 | 落一颗空心环 + 十字准星的编号图钉，下方弹出评论框并自动聚焦 | | 4 | 打字，按 **第一次回车** | 只确认**这一颗**图钉的内容；气泡收起，仍在标注模式，可以接着钉第 2、3… 颗 | | 5 | 全部写完，点「插入到输入框」 | 把**原图**（原字节、原分辨率）放进输入框；坐标说明先记在输入框上方的一枚 chip 里，**草稿保持干净**；预览自动关闭 | | 6 | 在输入框里补一句问题，按 **第二次回车** | 发送瞬间把 chip 里的清单拼进消息，一起发出去；chip 自动消失 | 要点：**第一次回车只确认图钉，第二次回车才是发出去** —— 因为图钉可以不止一个。 ### 输入框保持干净（chip） 坐标清单默认**不落进输入框**，只在输入框上方显示一枚 chip：`● 2 张图 · 3 处锚点 [查看] [清空]`。 - **查看**：弹出完整清单（就是模型会收到的内容），只读、可选中复制； - **清空**：丢弃这一轮的锚点记录（已经插进输入框的图片不动）； - **发送**：按回车或点发送按钮时，插件先把清单拼到你的问题后面，再交给宿主发送，chip 随之收起。 宿主版本拿不到 `setDraft` / `submit` 时（例如没有会话的极端情况），插件会退回老行为：把清单直接写进草稿，保证信息不丢。 再多张图也一样：接着点开第二张、钉点、插入 → 自动写成「图像 2」，锚点编号**重新从 1 开始**。 「图像 N」按这一批里被标注的顺序编号，块里同时给出尺寸和附件名，便于和输入框里的附件对上号。 其它交互： - 点已有图钉 = 重新编辑它的评论；拖动图钉 = 挪位置（坐标跟着变）； - 气泡里 `Esc` = 取消（备注为空时这颗钉一起删掉）、`Shift+Enter` = 换行、「删除」= 删掉这颗钉； - 同一张图再次打开：**之前的锚点会被预载回来**，编号延续，坐标块就地更新（不会出现第二份「图像 N」）； - 图本来就在输入框里（草稿附件）：只补坐标说明，**不会重复插一张一样的图**； - 预览右上角 `×` / `Esc` 关掉预览，整层随预览一起消失。 ## 安装 ### A. 本地开发（推荐先这样试） ```sh cd /path/to/dsh-image-pin-comment ./scripts/install-local.sh # 默认装进 desktop profile（DSH 桌面端） ./scripts/install-local.sh web # 或 web profile ``` 它做两件事：把插件目录 symlink 进 `~/.dsh/profiles//node_modules/`， 并在该 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里追加一行挂载配置（写之前会备份）。 然后刷新界面（⌘R）；若工具条没出现，重启一次 DSH。 卸载：`./scripts/install-local.sh --remove`。 ### B. 直接从 GitHub 装（推荐，不需要 npm） ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:dudhdkebesii/dsh-image-pin-comment ``` 装完重启一次 DSH（profile 的 bundle 组合在启动时展开）。 要固定版本也可以直接指向 tag：`github:dudhdkebesii/dsh-image-pin-comment#v0.2.0`。 不装 CLI 也行：桌面端 **设置 → 插件 → 添加插件** 里填 `github:dudhdkebesii/dsh-image-pin-comment`。 ### C. 从 Release 的 tarball 装（离线/内网） ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/dudhdkebesii/dsh-image-pin-comment/releases/latest/download/dsh-image-pin-comment.tgz ``` ### D. 从 npm 装（发布后可用） ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-image-pin-comment ``` 本仓库自带 `cordis.patch.yml`（`dsh.bundle.patch`），装成 bundle 时插件自己挂载自己。 双挂载有保护：bundle 行与本地 install.sh 同时命中时只挂一份。 ## 它怎么工作（给改代码的人） 两个半边，都在 `lib/`： - `lib/index.js`：宿主半边，故意是空的；只负责给 loader 一个 entry，让 `dsh-client-modules` 扫到 `package.json` 里的 `dsh.client` 与 `exports["./client"]`。 - `lib/client.js`：浏览器半边，手写、无构建、不 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai/*`。 几处关键实现： | 环节 | 做法 | 为什么 | | --- | --- | --- | | 挂载点 | 只认一个稳定特征：`body > div[role="dialog"][aria-modal="true"]` 且直接子元素里有 ``（`ImageLightbox`），节流 `MutationObserver` 扫描，出现即挂、移除即销毁 | 不注册 slot、不动 React 树，官方改内部 API 也影响不到 | | 坐标 | 图钉一律存「原图像素」；显示时按 `rect.width / naturalWidth` 缩放，百分比在生成文本时现算 | 缩放窗口、换 DPI、导出三处永远一致 | | 图钉外观 | 空心环 + 中心留空的十字准星 + 右上角编号徽标 | 被指的字符不会被钉挡住（对着截图问「这是什么字」时全靠这点） | | 发原图 | `fetch(src)` 取回原始字节，按原扩展名作为附件塞进输入框；拿不到才退回「像素副本」 | 模型看到干净原图；不重编码、不动分辨率 | | 文本投递 | 一级 `inputActions.setDraft`（通过只读的 `conversation.input.overlay` 桥接组件拿到）→ 二级合成文本 paste → 三级 `execCommand` → 四级复制到剪贴板 | 全走 DSH 自己的入口；每级都有兜底 | | 一批多图 | `draftBatch` 按图片 `src` 记账，记录每张图已写进草稿的块；再次标注同一张图时预载锚点并就地替换该块 | 「图像 N 的锚点 1..k」永远指同一张图的同一批点，不串号 | | 草稿比对 | 空白归一化 + 下标映射后再定位块（Lexical 的 `innerText` 是 `\n\n`，我们写进去的是 `\n`） | 判断「上一批是否已经发出去」，并在原始文本上精确 splice | | 会话键 | bridge 组件卸载时只标记失效、不清空，会话键记住最后一次看到的值 | composer 重渲染的瞬间不会把多图编号清掉 | ## 自测 三档，从便宜到可信： | 脚本 | 跑什么 | 结果 | | --- | --- | --- | | `npm run check` | `node --check` 两个半边 | 语法 | | `node test/smoke.mjs` | 真实 Chrome（headless + CDP）加载 `test/fixture.html`（复刻 `ImageLightbox` + composer 的离线夹具）；bridge 档位（chip + 发送拦截）**33 / 33**，兜底档位（直接写草稿）**22 / 22** | **全部通过** | | `node test/real-flow.mjs ` | 真实 dsh 实例 + 真 composer + 真 lightbox：paste 两张图 → 分别钉点 → 插入 → 回车发送（submit 用桩替换，不真发） | **14 / 14** | `test/smoke.mjs` 覆盖的断言（A/B/C/D/E 五段场景）： - **A** 未进标注模式点图不落钉；进模式后落钉、气泡聚焦；第一次回车只确认备注、**不触发任何发送**； 锚点中心保持透明（不遮字）、环上有颜色； 发出去的是**原图**（整张图 0 个红点、锚点位置像素 = 原图灰度）；附件名 `image-1-*.png`； **插入后草稿里没有坐标块，只多了一枚 chip**（`1 张图 · 2 处锚点`）；用户自己写的问题保持原样。 - **B** 第二张图 → 「图像 2（900×600）」+ chip 变 `2 张图 · 3 处锚点`，锚点编号**重新从 1 开始**。 - **C** 同一张图再打开 → 预载旧锚点；chip 的锚点数涨到 4，同一张图不会重复插附件。 - **D** 已经在输入框里的图 → 只补记录（`已在输入框中`），附件数不变，chip 变 `3 张图 · 5 处锚点`； - **E** 在输入框打一句话按回车 → 清单被拼到问题后面并调用 `submit`，chip 收起；提交内容含三张图的块、`px`、`±容差`、`裁切框`。 重新生成夹具：`node test/build-fixture.mjs`；重新拍预览图：`node test/screenshot.mjs`。 ### 真机验证：开一个隔离实例（不碰你自己的 `~/.dsh`） ```sh APP="/Applications/DSH Desktop.app/Contents/Resources/app" CLI="$APP/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js" # 1) 在临时 DSH_HOME 里造一个 web profile（复制 web 模板，不联网） DSH_HOME=/tmp/dsh-home node "$CLI" --profile piniso --from-default-profile web --dump-config DSH_HOME=/tmp/dsh-home ./scripts/install-local.sh piniso # 2) 起一个隔离的 web 实例（port 0 = 系统随便给一个），记下打印出来的 token URL DSH_HOME=/tmp/dsh-home node "$CLI" --profile piniso --no-open --port 0 # 3) 另一个终端跑真机链路 node test/real-flow.mjs "http://127.0.0.1:/?token=" # 4) 收工 rm -rf /tmp/dsh-home ``` `test/real-e2e.mjs ` 是更轻的一档：只验证 client bundle 加载、boot 清单收录、 locale / 主题 token 可用、观察器在真实外壳里挂上预览、图钉与气泡可用。 调试：控制台里 `__dshImagePinComment.annotators[0].state` 看实时状态； `localStorage.setItem('dsh-image-pin-comment.debug', '1')` 打开详细日志。 ## 已知限制 - 坐标是**点**，不是框。要框选请配合 `dsh-image-annotate` 那类画笔插件使用。 - 只接管 DSH 自己的图片预览（lightbox）；输入框草稿缩略图点开走同一个预览，因此同样可用。 - 消息气泡里不渲染「标注 ×N」chip（第一版只做核心链路）；坐标块作为普通文本随消息发出。 - 不提供设置页；工具条文案跟随 DSH 的 `locale`（zh / en）。 - 一次标记太多张图时坐标块会变长（每张图一块，带像素与裁切框）——刻意的取舍： 宁可文字长一点，也不要模型去猜。 ## 开源方案对照（为什么是这个做法） 调研过 DSH 生态里所有图片标注类插件（2026-10 快照），与本需求的重合度： | 项目 | 能力 | 与本需求的差距 | | --- | --- | --- | | [zhishengplus/dsh-image-annotate](https://github.com/zhishengplus/dsh-image-annotate) · MIT | 预览上加画笔/箭头/框/圆圈/文字，原分辨率导出进输入框 | 没有图钉，不产出坐标文本 | | [janewas/dsh-image-annotate](https://github.com/janewas/dsh-image-annotate) · MIT | 输入框待发图片就地标注，作为第二张附件插回 | 同上，且只针对草稿图 | | [heshuren371/dsh-annotator](https://github.com/heshuren371/dsh-annotator) · MIT | 网页/图片上**画框**+描述，Agent 拿到框坐标与 DOM | 是框不是钉，且是 agent preset + host 路由的重架构 | | [Max-Null/dsh-capture](https://github.com/Max-Null/dsh-capture) | 截图 + 框选 + 红框标注进输入框 | 面向截图，不是对已上传图片打点 | | [omdsh-dev/dsh-annotation](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-annotation) · MIT | 文本选区批注随消息发送、逐条编号回复 | 对象是文字不是图片，但「编号清单」的思路可借鉴 | 结论：**没有「图钉 + 坐标清单」的现成实现**，但「预览叠加 + 原图像素坐标 + 合成 paste 投递」 这套骨架已被上面两个插件在真实 DSH 上验证过，所以本插件沿用它（MIT，已在 LICENSE 里标注）， 只把「画笔」换成「图钉 + 评论 + 坐标清单」。 ## License MIT。见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)（含上游 dsh-image-annotate 的版权声明）。 与 DeepSeek 官方无关，未获其许可或背书。

plugins.description: Claude-Desktop-style Projects sidebar plugin for DeepSeek Harness Desktop: group conversations into projects, per-conversation working directories, drag-and-drop migration, permanent empty-conversation cleanup.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-projects

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@wxysskd/dsh-projects.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@wxysskd/dsh-projects) [![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

Claude-Desktop-style **Projects** for **DSH Desktop** (the `desktop` DSH profile
only — Web and headless profiles are untouched).

The shipped DSH sidebar groups conversations by Workspace (directory). This
plugin replaces that sidebar region with a project-first browser:

- create **projects** (name, color, one or more working directories);
- every conversation lives inside a project;
- **each conversation can use a different directory**, chosen when it is
  created (or switched later through *Change working directory*), backed by the
  Host's real `workingDirectory` service — the same durable, model-visible
  mechanism as the `working_directory` tool;
- sessions outside any project stay visible under **Other conversations**,
  still grouped by Workspace, so nothing is lost;
- **empty conversations are hidden and can be deleted for real**: the Host keeps
  reusable blank Sessions from every "New Session" click (`blank: true`); only
  the empty Session that is currently open is shown. The Host also scans legacy
  Sessions whose catalog row is not marked blank but whose log contains no
  conversation events at all (only tiny header/metadata logs are inspected), so
  old "Badstuff"-style empty chats are hidden too. *View options → Delete empty
  conversations (N)* permanently removes both kinds from disk through a
  validated Host route (never touches a conversation with content; sessions
  still live in the current app run are archived and can be purged after the
  next start);
- **projects keep the workspace hierarchy**: inside a project, conversations
  stay grouped under their workspace (folder + title + count), so moving a
  workspace into a project preserves its identity instead of flattening the
  chats; workspace headers have their own `+` (new conversation directly in
  that directory — assigned to the containing project, or ungrouped under
  *Other conversations*) and `⋯` menu (new conversation, move to another
  project, rename, remove from project, delete workspace);
- pinned sessions, relative times, running/pending/unread status dots,
  archive/unarchive, rename, fork, pin and copy-ID work from the new rows.

## Install (desktop profile)

The plugin ships as a normal DSH bundle and is published on npm as
**[`@wxysskd/dsh-projects`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@wxysskd/dsh-projects)**.
Three equivalent ways to install it into the **desktop** profile
(`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`):

```bash
# 1. from npm (registry install; also works from Plugins -> Add plugin)
plugin_manager install_bundle target=@wxysskd/dsh-projects@1.0.0
#   or: desktop-cli plugin --profile desktop add @wxysskd/dsh-projects@1.0.0

# 2. from the self-contained release tarball
npm run pack                                  # -> dist/wxysskd-dsh-projects-1.0.0.tgz
plugin_manager install_bundle target=/abs/path/dist/wxysskd-dsh-projects-1.0.0.tgz

# 3. source link for development (client.js edits hot-reload)
desktop-cli plugin --profile desktop add link:"$PWD"
```

The npm package contains only runtime files (`index.js`, `client.js`,
`cordis.patch.yml`, `locale/*.json`, `icon.svg`, `package.json`, `README.md`,
`LICENSE`), plus `SHA-256`/manifest in `dist/`. See
[docs/INSTALL.md](docs/INSTALL.md) for installation, the market index,
activation/verification and rollback details.

## Plugin market (Discover tab)

DSH has no official built-in market; the Discover tab reads index sources the
user adds. This repository publishes a format-1 index with a commit-pinned Git
install target:

```
https://aobakaolengmian.github.io/dsh-projects/market/index.json
```

Add that URL as an index source in **Plugins → Discover** and install
**Projects** from the card; the same index is readable by the `plugin_market`
tool and by any other DSH Desktop user:

![Projects in the Discover tab](docs/preview-market.png)

The market entry installs the published npm package
(`@wxysskd/dsh-projects@<version>`), the same artifact as the tarball. See
[market/README.md](market/README.md) for the format and how to regenerate it
(`npm run market`). Installing from the market still needs one app restart for
the Host row.

## Data

Project metadata is Host-owned and durable, independent of session logs:

- `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-projects.json` — projects, session→project
  assignments, last recorded working directory per session;
- sessions themselves stay owned by the Session Controller (nothing is
  rewritten into session logs by this plugin).

HTTP routes served from the existing DSH web server (same origin as the GUI):

| Method | Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/dsh-projects/state` | complete project state |
| GET | `/dsh-projects/health` | liveness + counts |
| POST | `/dsh-projects/mutate` | `project.create`, `project.update`, `project.delete`, `session.assign` |
| POST | `/dsh-projects/cwd` | change one conversation's working directory |
| POST | `/dsh-projects/purge` | permanently remove validated empty sessions (rejects content) |
| GET | `/dsh-projects/empty-sessions` | list sessions that hold no conversation content |

POST routes require `content-type: application/json` and `x-dsh-projects: 1`
and a 64 KiB body limit.

## Build

```
npm install          # dev-only: esbuild, react, react-dom, playwright
node scripts/build.mjs   # src/client/* -> client.js (committed artifact)
npm run pack             # build + dist/<name>-<version>.tgz + SHA-256 + manifest
node harness/build.mjs   # mock harness bundle
node harness/shoot.mjs   # screenshots -> harness/shots/
npm test                 # host/model tests (node --test)
```

## Design notes

- The browser entry registers into the shipped `sidebar.workspaces` single slot
  at `priority: -1`, shadowing `ui-workspace`'s browser. The shipped entry stays
  registered underneath: if our component crashes, its entry is abdicated and
  the original sidebar comes back.
- The client bundle imports only `react` / `react-dom` / `react/jsx-runtime`
  from the shell's shared module table and uses `ctx` services for everything
  else (`sessions`, `workspaces`, `uiWorkspace`, `locale`, `slots`).
- Styles use `--dsw-*` theme tokens; literals are limited to project accent
  artwork. All classes are prefixed `pj-`.

## Moving workspaces and conversations between projects

Everything can be migrated without deleting or recreating sessions, through the
project metadata only (session logs are never touched):

- **Drag a conversation row** onto any project section → the session is assigned
  to that project (drag it onto *Other conversations* to remove it from its
  project).
- **Drag a workspace group header** (under *Other conversations*) onto any
  project section → the directory moves into that project (removed from any
  other project's directory list, never duplicated) and every conversation in
  that directory is assigned to it. While dragging, every project shows a
  dashed drop outline and the hovered target is highlighted.
- **Menu path** (same result without dragging):
  - workspace group `⋯` → *Move workspace to project* → pick the target;
  - project `⋯` → *Move working directory to another project…* → pick the
    directory → pick the target project (or *Remove from project (back to Other
    conversations)*);
  - conversation `⋯` → *Move to project* → pick the target (or *No project*).

Moving a directory between projects also makes future sessions created in that
directory (including the shipped Cmd+N flow) land in the target project, and the
project keeps the workspace title as a nested folder group.

Workspace headers (both inside projects and under *Other conversations*) expose
their own menu: **Rename workspace…**, **Move workspace to project**, **Remove
from project** and **Delete workspace**. Deleting a workspace removes only its
registration, puts its conversations back under *Other conversations*, and never
deletes a conversation.

## Compatibility with other sidebar plugins

The installed sidebar-touching pl

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：侧栏工作区文件树右键，一键把文件/文件夹以原生 @引用 chip 插入输入框｜Right-click a file-tree row to insert a native @ reference chip into the composer.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-file-reference

**右键**一键引用：把侧栏「工作区文件」树里的文件/文件夹、或消息里**已交付的文件卡片**，以原生 `@路径` 引用 chip 插进当前会话输入框。

DeepSeek Harness 里想引用一个文件，只能手打 `@` 再一层层找；而侧栏文件树只有**左键**一个手势（点文件=打开预览、点目录=展开），交付文件卡片也没有引用入口。本插件补上**右键**这一步，走的是宿主自己的引用通道，不自造协议。

## 效果

在右侧栏「工作区文件」面板里**右键**任意文件或文件夹行，或者在消息里**右键已交付的文件卡片**（例如收尾回复下方的 `combo_index.html` 卡片）：

| 菜单项 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| **引用到会话** | 把该条目以 `@路径` chip 插入当前会话输入框——与把文件拖进输入框**同一条宿主通道**，插入的是真正的引用 chip，发送时宿主按文件引用解析 |
| **复制引用文本** | 把 `@路径` 文本写入剪贴板 |

- 路径自动折算成相对当前会话工作区的相对路径；含空格的路径自动加引号（`@"my dir/readme.md"`）；目录尾随 `/`。
- 插入成功自动聚焦输入框；会话未挂载、正在发送或输入框拒绝插入时**给出提示**，不静默失败。
- 命中不到路径时**不拦截右键**，浏览器的默认行为照常。
- 菜单样式全取宿主主题令牌，亮暗主题跟随；点击别处、Esc、滚动、窗口失焦自动关闭。
- 中英双语，跟随宿主语言。

## 安装

> **发布状态**：本插件目前只在 GitHub 发布，**尚未发布到 npm**。下面标注「npm 未发布」的写法暂不可用，等发布后再用。

### 方式一 · 插件页添加（桌面版用户，推荐）

DSH 桌面版：打开侧边栏**插件**页 → **添加插件** → 粘贴下面一行 → 装完点**启用** → 按提示重启或刷新。

```
https://github.com/dyhdesu/dsh-file-reference
```

### 方式二 · 命令行（web / headless profile）

```
dsh plugin --profile web add github:dyhdesu/dsh-file-reference
```

装完重启 `dsh web`，浏览器硬刷新。

npm 发布后可直接用包名安装（**当前 npm 未发布，此条暂不可用**）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-file-reference
```

### 方式三 · 本地目录接线（开发用）

`desktop` profile 由 Electron 应用独占管理，官方 CLI 会拒绝直接写入（`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`）。自己开发时走手动接线：

```sh
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
```

在该目录的 `package.json` 里，`dependencies` 增加一条指向本目录的 `file:` 依赖，并在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里追加 `"dsh-file-reference"`；然后在同目录执行安装并重启桌面版。

```
pnpm install
```

改完源码后同步安装副本，client 半区刷新页面即生效：

```
rsync -a --delete src/ ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-file-reference/src/
```

## 原理

- 两个右键表面都由一个纯逻辑函数 `contextTarget()` 判定，命中才拦截：
  - **侧栏文件树行**：官方文件树（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-files`）的行节点带 `data-files-entry="file|directory"` 与 `data-files-path="绝对路径"`，树根带 `data-files-root`；官方树本身没有任何右键处理，这块手势是空的。
  - **交付文件卡片**：官方交付卡片（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-deliverables`）是 `div[data-presented-file]`，其中**只作标记、不带路径**；绝对路径在卡片内**首个带 `title` 的节点**（预览按钮，官方 `resolveWorkspacePath(cwd, file.path)`）上。该 `title` 是非 i18n 的，但属于官方**内部实现**而非公开契约——因此插件按**文档顺序**取第一个非空 `title`，取不到就完全不拦截右键。卡片位于正文中，归属即当前会话，无需树根纠偏。
- 插入走宿主 `conversation` 服务的 `input.shell(sessionId).addFiles([reference], [])`，即 `SessionInputShell.addFiles`——官方给引用 chip 留的程序化入口（内部走 `draftEditor.insertFileReferences`）；chip 形态 `{source:'reference', ref, label, appearance, clipboardText}` 与官方 `@` 菜单、拖文件进输入框**完全一致**，不是自造协议。
- 当前会话由 `uiSession.current.value.key` 提供；多会话时按文件树根路径与会话 `cwd` 比对纠偏，避免把引用插进别的会话。
- 与官方 `@` 引用语义对齐：引用只携带**路径**，不读取也不附带文件内容（官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-file-reference` 明文规定「选中候选绝不读取或附带文件内容」），模型要看内容必须自己调文件系统工具。
- **纯前端插件**：host 半区为空操作（`export function apply() {}`），不碰宿主源码、不注册路由、不改配置，装卸无残留；HMR 重评估时先拆上一代句柄（监听器、菜单、代际槽）。

## 兼容性

- 在 **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2**（macOS 桌面版）上开发与验证。
- **Windows**：路径处理对齐官方文件树的混合分隔符契约（官方 `childPath` 以 `/` 拼接、宿主解析混合分隔符），盘符与 UNC 形态按大小写不敏感比对，POSIX 形态仍严格区分大小写。盘符、反斜杠与混合分隔符、盘符大小写差异、UNC 四种形态均有单元测试覆盖；**尚未在 Windows 实机验收**。
- 依赖官方文件树的行属性契约（`data-files-entry` / `data-files-path` / `data-files-root`）、交付卡片的 `data-presented-file` 标记与其预览按钮的 `title`、以及 `SessionInputShell.addFiles`。官方若改动这三处，插件需要跟进；已做降级：服务缺失、结构不匹配或取不到路径时既不抛异常，也不拦截右键。
- 输入框中的引用 chip 形态与官方 `@` 菜单、拖拽入文件一致，因此引用在草稿恢复、跨工作区切换等场景下与官方行为一致。

## 已知局限

- 一次只处理单行：暂不支持多选批量引用。
- 右键覆盖侧栏文件树行与**交付文件卡片**两处；消息里已渲染的 `@` 引用 chip、改动文件卡片的行、收尾正文的行内文件链接暂不在范围内。
- 交付卡片依赖官方 `title` 这个内部实现细节；官方改版后可能失效（表现为右键不再弹菜单，不影响其它功能）。
- 目录引用只插入 `@目录/`，不展开目录内容（官方 `@` 菜单的 Tab 下钻能力未复刻）。
- 引用 chip 插入需要会话已挂载且输入框可编辑；发送中会被宿主拒绝并提示。

## 开发与测试

```sh
npm test
```

45 项用例覆盖：路径归一化与 `@` 语法（含空格引号、目录尾斜杠、控制字符拒绝）、**Windows 形态**（盘符、反斜杠与混合分隔符、盘符大小写差异、UNC、根前缀兄弟目录不误判）、chip 载荷构造、会话归属判定、**右键命中判定**（树行/交付卡片/树外与无 title 不拦截）、菜单生命周期与拆卸、服务全缺时的降级，以及 `src/client.js` 内联逻辑段与 `src/logic.mjs` 的**逐字同源校验**（防止两侧逻辑漂移）。

## 许可

MIT © 2026 dyhdesu

plugins.description: 给 DSH Desktop 的鲸鱼壁纸插件：一片会游动的海铺在界面背后，控制台 20 项实时可调
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-whale-pond 🐋

> 一只在深海里慢慢游的鲸鱼，把它的自留地铺在 **DSH** 的 Web 界面背后（桌面端窗口，或浏览器里打开的 `dsh web`）。
> 纯视觉背景插件：**不拦鼠标、不抢键盘、不碰任何业务代码**。

[![release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/wenwubei5/dsh-whale-pond?color=2b6cb0)](https://github.com/wenwubei5/dsh-whale-pond/releases/latest)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE)
[![DSH Desktop](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH%20Desktop-0.2.0--rc.2-1f2937)](https://github.com/wenwubei5/dsh-whale-pond)


## 它是什么

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的 Web 界面背后本来是一块不透明背景。这个插件在 `z-index:-1` 挂一张
`position:fixed` 的全屏 canvas，再把界面自己的背景 token 调成半透明玻璃 —— 于是海、光点、水母、
鲸鱼就从界面底下透出来了：

- 默认 **400 颗光点**在海里飘（可拉到 2100），鲸鱼游过去把它们吃掉，头上飘一行 `-1 token`
- 鼠标是一盏**提灯**，带着洋流把光点往鲸鱼嘴边赶
- 右下角有个**发射区**：鼠标进圈，圈里的光点和鲸鱼一起被甩出去（最远约 4 倍圈直径）
- 右上角齿轮 ⚙ 是**控制台**：12 个滑杆 + 7 个开关 + 1 个下拉 + 1 个词库框 + 5 个按钮，改完立刻变
- 齿轮左边还有一个 **■ / ▶ 一键停用**：动画停、玻璃撤掉、界面回到原样，设置会记住
- **看海模式**：一键全屏屏保（盖住界面文字，专心看鲸鱼吃光点），或弹出的可拖动 / 可缩放小窗（浮在界面上摸鱼）；点画面或按 Esc 退出
- **五种运动方式**（漂移 / 飘落 / 上浮 / 洋流 / 漩涡）+ **呼吸灯**，和鼠标吸引、发射台叠加生效
- 深浅色主题自动跟随；`prefers-reduced-motion` 时跑 120 帧后定格；页面隐藏时暂停


## 安装

前提：**页面必须是 DSH 自己的 Web 界面** —— 桌面端窗口，或者用 `dsh web` 起在浏览器里打开，两者都行
（见下面「在浏览器里用」）。插件走的是 DSH 的客户端插件机制（`window.__ModuleLoader__`），所以不能当普通
`<script>` 塞进别的网页；但它**不是 Electron 专属**，Chromium 内核的浏览器里实测正常。
仓库里已经带了生成好的 `lib/client.js`，**装的时候不需要 Node、不需要 Python、不需要构建**。

### 方式 A：一条命令从 GitHub 直装（推荐）

```bash
# 1) 先确认活动 profile —— 这个文件里 "active" 那一项就是（常见 desktop / web）
cat "$APPDATA/DSH Desktop/profile-selection"

# 2) 用桌面端自带的 CLI，把 GitHub 上的包直接装进 profile（dsh 一般不在 PATH 里）
DSH="/c/Program Files/DSH Desktop"        # 换成你自己的安装目录
ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 DSH_HOME="$HOME/.dsh" "$DSH/DSH Desktop.exe" \
  --expose-internals "$DSH/resources/app/lib/desktop-cli.js" \
  plugin --profile desktop add "github:wenwubei5/dsh-whale-pond"
```

`plugin add` 后面的参数是**原样转给 pnpm** 的，所以三种写法都行：

| 写法 | 例子 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GitHub 简写 | `github:wenwubei5/dsh-whale-pond` | 装当前 main 的最新提交 |
| git URL | `git+https://github.com/wenwubei5/dsh-whale-pond.git` | 同上，可加 `#v1.0.0` 钉版本 |
| 本地目录 | `"D:/code/dsh-whale-pond"` | 装成 `link:`，改源码刷新即生效 |

### 方式 B：先 clone 再装（想改源码用这个）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/wenwubei5/dsh-whale-pond.git "D:/code/dsh-whale-pond"
# 然后照上面第 2 步，最后一段换成：
#   plugin --profile desktop add "D:/code/dsh-whale-pond"
```

改完 `src/whale_pond.html` 或 `src/whale_panel.js` 后跑 `python build/build.py` 重新生成
`lib/client.js`（只要 Python 3 + 标准库，没有第三方依赖）。

**新增插件包必须重启一次 DSH**（客户端入口要重新扫描）。之后再改代码就只要刷新页面（Ctrl+R）。
从 GitHub 装的是**中性默认词**版本；你自己的词库存在 `localStorage`，不受影响。

### 方式 C：下载 zip（离线 / 机器上没有 git）

到 [Releases](https://github.com/wenwubei5/dsh-whale-pond/releases/latest) 下载 `dsh-whale-pond-1.2.0.zip`
（约 50 KB，里面是 `package.json` + `lib/` + `cordis.patch.yml` + `README.md` + `LICENSE`），
解压出 `dsh-whale-pond/`，再把上面的命令最后一段换成那个目录：

```bash
... plugin --profile desktop add "D:/下载/dsh-whale-pond"
```

zip 里的 `lib/client.js` 就是生成好的产物（59,680 B），解压即可用，不需要构建。

卸载：把上面的 `add` 换成 `remove`。

### 在浏览器里用（不打开桌面端窗口）

插件跑在 DSH 的 Web 界面里，所以只要页面是 DSH 提供的，用浏览器打开效果完全一样。桌面端自带的 CLI 就能起
一个纯 Web 实例：

```bash
DSH="/c/Program Files/DSH Desktop"          # 换成你自己的安装目录
ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 DSH_HOME="$HOME/.dsh" "$DSH/DSH Desktop.exe" \
  --expose-internals "$DSH/resources/app/lib/desktop-cli.js" \
  --profile web --port 4407 --no-open
```

它会打印一行 `http://127.0.0.1:4407/?token=…`，复制到 Chrome / Edge 里打开就有鲸鱼、光点和控制台。
**插件要装进提供这个页面的那个 profile** —— 上面安装命令里的 `--profile desktop` 换成 `--profile web` 即可。

两点要知道：

- 桌面端窗口自己那个端口（默认 `43120`）是给 Electron 渲染进程用的：浏览器直接开会被 DSH 的鉴权挡住（401），
  插件路由还带 `x-dsh-desktop-renderer` 头校验。这是宿主自己的限制，跟插件无关。
- 实测用的是 Chromium 内核（Chrome / Edge）；Firefox / Safari 没测，理论上没问题（只用到 canvas 2D、CSS 变量和 localStorage）。

## 控制台

界面右上角的小齿轮 ⚙（悬停变亮）点开就是控制台，拖动即时生效、不用刷新。
设置存在 `localStorage['whale-pond-settings-v1']`（词库单独一个键），面板底部「恢复默认（词库保留）」一键回默认。

| 分组 | 控件 | 默认 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 开关 | 启用壁纸 ☑（和右上角 ■ / ▶ 等价） | 开 |
| 看海 | 全屏屏保 · 小窗摸鱼 · 回到壁纸（三个按钮，当前生效那个亮橙） | 壁纸模式 |
| 界面 | 面板不透明度 · 画布亮度 | 0.34 · 1.6 |
| 海 | 光点数量 · 光点速度 | 400 · 1.0 |
| 鼠标（提灯） | 洋流吸引光点 ☑ · 吸引半径 · 吸引强度 · 显示吸引范围光环 ☑ | 340px · 1.0 |
| 吃光点 | 飘字「-1 token」☑ · 飘字「吃掉「词」」☑ | 都开 |
| 词库 | 一行一个词，最多 200 个 / 每个 24 字，改一下存一下 | 内建 10 个词 |
| 右下角发射台 | 启用发射台 ☑ · 圈半径 · 距右下角 · 弹射力度 | 170px · 132px · 4.0 |
| 光点运动 | 运动方式 · 运动强度 · 呼吸灯 ☐ · 呼吸快慢 | 漂移 · 1.0 · 关 · 1.0 |
| 性能 | 内部清晰度 · 运行状态（只读） | 1.0 |

## 停用 / 恢复

要认真工作、不想再看海的时候，点右上角齿轮左边那个 **■** 就停（停用后按钮变成 **▶**、亮橙色，再点一下回来）；
也可以打开控制台，最上面「开关」组里取消「启用壁纸」。两条路等价，状态存在 localStorage，**刷新页面依然是停的**。

它是真停，不是把画布藏起来：

- `cancelAnimationFrame` 停掉动画，canvas `display:none`；
- 120ms 吃光点、12s 造带词光点两个定时器和补货入口都提前返回；
- 宿主那层玻璃**整份撤掉**（`tokens.reset()`：body 的 `background:transparent !important` 与 8 个 `--dsw-alias-bg-*` 覆盖全部移除），界面回到原本不透明的深色；
- 齿轮与面板留着当入口（齿轮降到 0.3 透明度），控制台「运行状态」会写「已停用 · 动画停、玻璃已撤」。

恢复时按 `tokens.apply()` → `run()` → 补齐光点数 的顺序来，不会出现「海回来了但界面还是实心」的中间态。
真页面实测：停用前 1.2 秒画 28,263 个弧，停用后同一窗口 **0** 个；禁缓存重载后仍 `display:none` / 0 弧，勾回来立刻恢复到 27,287 个弧。

## 看海：全屏屏保 · 小窗摸鱼

控制台最上面「看海」组里三个按钮（别和齿轮左边那个 ■ / ▶ 停用混起来）：

- **全屏屏保** —— 整片海铺满窗口，把界面文字全盖住，鲸鱼和光点在整屏里游。底部会浮出一条
  「点击画面或按 Esc 退出」的胶囊提示，5 秒后自己淡出。副屏上放着纯看很合适。
- **小窗摸鱼** —— 一个约 280×180 的圆角小海窗浮在右下角，界面照常能点能用；拖窗内任意处移动，
  拖右下角手柄缩放（280×180 ~ 560×347）。窗口一直被夹在视口里，不会拖丢。
- **回到壁纸** —— 回到正常的「铺满整个界面背后」模式。

三种模式互斥，当前生效的按钮亮橙色。这个**模式本身不记忆**：刷新页面就回到壁纸模式
（「启用壁纸」那个停用开关倒是会记住）。

实现上三件事值得说：

- 看海时画布**离开 `z-index:-1`**：小窗 `2147482990`、全屏 `2147483002`（压在界面上，也压住自己的齿轮和面板），
  提示条 `2147483003`。回壁纸再回到 `-1` 并恢复 `pointer-events:none`。
- 进看海先把玻璃背景**整份撤掉**（`tokens.reset()`），否则小窗后面还是透的、看不清；回壁纸且没停用时再 `tokens.apply()`。
- 画布尺寸一变就按比例**重排光点**（`rebaseMotes`：坐标等比缩放 + 绕屏回绕），不会有光点被甩到画布外；
  小窗里鼠标坐标要减去窗口偏移，提灯才会指哪儿亮哪儿。

真页面实测（754×440 视口）：全屏 canvas `rect [0,0,754,440]`、`z-index 2147483002`、界面 token 全空（玻璃撤净）；
小窗 `z-index 2147482990`、拖动 -60/+40 跟手、缩放 280×180 → 360×240、手柄跟着走；Esc 退出后宿主收到的 Escape 次数 **0**
（不会顺手取消掉你正在生成的回答）；停用壁纸时若正在看海，会自动回到壁纸并 `display:none`。

## 实现要点（这些坑都踩过）

- **canvas 要 `z-index:-1`，但光这样是看不见的**：body 自己的不透明背景画在负 z-index 后代之上，
  样式表压不住主题规则 —— 必须 `document.body.style.setProperty("background","transparent","important")`（inline + important 实测必胜）。
- **设计 token 定义在 body 上、不在 html 上**：往 `documentElement` 写等于白写。token 覆盖成半透明后，
  界面自己就变玻璃了（透明度表在 `lib/client.js` 的 `TOKENS`）。
- **背景要烘焙**：海面渐变 + 暗角很贵，改成离屏 canvas 各烘一次（背景 1/4 分辨率、暗角只在建立或改尺寸时烘），
  每秒的离屏重绘像素量从 3.3M 降到 254K。
- **光点要批量画**：按类型分 4 桶、每桶一次 `fill()`；呼吸灯再按 3 档亮度分桶（每帧 fill 29 → 45，仍然不掉帧）。
- **「跟手」得用阻尼弹簧 + 距离比例力**：把弹簧力写成单位向量会让拉力弱约 100 倍，光点「越赶越散」。
- **发射出去的光点要免疫鼠标吸引**（`if(lamp.on && !(m.lz>0))`），否则会被鼠标自己拽回来、飞不远。
- **帧门 `if(dt < 24) return;` + `document.hidden` 暂停 + DPR ≤ 1.5 + 32fps 上限**，4K 屏也稳。
- **停用要做成「可逆的拆除」**：rAF 只留一个入口（`run()`），停时 `cancelAnimationFrame` 并把 `running` 置假；画布 `display:none` 比停止绘制更彻底（连合成都不做）；玻璃背景必须 `tokens.reset()` 逐个 `removeProperty`，只覆盖不撤会永远留着半透明。
- **看海时的 Esc 必须拦在捕获阶段**：面板的 keydown 监听挂在 `document` 捕获阶段（第三参 `true`），看海模式下 `preventDefault + stopPropagation` 再退出，宿主收不到这次 Esc（DSH 里 Esc = 取消生成）；面板关着时不能拦，得让它照常穿透。
- **小窗要整只夹在视口里**（`Math.max(4, Math.min(vh - h - 4, y))`），提示条贴底时改挂到小窗上方，否则固定挂在下方会被视口切掉、截图里根本看不见。

## 改它

```
src/whale_pond.html   # 原版海洋小游戏 —— 物理与绘制的来源（build.py 按行号引用它）
src/whale_panel.js    # 控制台（面板）源码
build/build.py        # 生成器：按行号剪裁 src/whale_pond.html + 注入补丁 → lib/client.js
lib/client.js         # 生成产物（已提交，装完即用，不需要构建工具）
test/harness.html     # 离线夹具：假 __ModuleLoader__ + 手动 rAF 泵，无头浏览器 3 秒跑完
test/probes/*.js      # 真页面 CDP 探针（看海模式 / 停用开关 / 运动方式 / 控制台 / 词库 / 发射区 / 越界值 / 全控件扫描）
```

重建（会重写 `lib/client.js`、`cordis.patch.yml`、`package.json`）：

```bash
python build/build.py
node --check lib/client.js
```

### 离线夹具（不用起 DSH）

```bash
msedge --headless=new --disable-gpu --no-sandbox --virtual-time-budget=300000 \
  --dump-dom "file:///$(pwd)/test/harness.html" | grep -o 'RESULT {.*}'
```

夹具返回一大坨 JSON：每帧 `arc` 调用数、光点数量、控制台 20 个控件的读数、
五种运动方式的平均位移（最近邻匹配）、呼吸灯的半径分布、离屏烘焙成本，
以及两个历史 bug 的回归项（面板开着时 Esc 不穿透、localStorage 越界值自动夹紧）。

### 真页面探针

先起一个测试用的 DSH 实例，再用无头 Edge 连上去：

```bash
node test/front.mjs 4406                        # 让标签页前台化（否则 rAF 一帧不发）
node test/cdp.mjs test/probes/motion.js shot.png 4406
```

`test/cdp.mjs <探针.js> <截图.png|""> <url 子串>`，截图参数传空串就只求值。

## English

A purely visual wallpaper plugin for **DSH Desktop**: a whale, drifting motes and jellyfish are
drawn on a fixed `z-index:-1` canvas behind the web

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness sidebar dashboard plugin: task progress, downloads/extraction, training, tests, local+SSH GPU monitoring
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-dashboard

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web UI 侧边栏插件：在左侧新增「项目看板」，把任务进度、下载/解压、模型训练、测试结果和 GPU 状态集中到一个紧凑面板。

## 功能

- **紧凑单面板**：顶部任务进度卡 + 任务 / 下载 / 训练 / 测试 / 传输五个页签，列表在面板内滚动。
- **任务进度**：读取工作区任务计划，结合服务器产物与运行中的进程推断每项任务的状态、进度和下一步（转换、校验、训练、评测进程会自动识别）。
- **下载与解压**：本地下载目录与远端 raw 目录；归档显示已解压体积/文件数，解压中显示百分比和当前第几个压缩包。
- **模型训练**：最近的训练产物；GPU 支持**本机 + 多台远端**（`remoteAliases`），每个来源一组，显示利用率、显存、温度、功耗、风扇、频率、驱动、占用进程，以及该机器的 CPU / 内存 / load；每张卡带一条最近约 30 个采样的利用率迷你趋势线。
- **测试信息**：pytest 历史（每个 run 目录取最新一份日志）、评测指标和结果目录。
- **传输**：新增「传输」页签，显示 dsh-ssh 文件传输的**方向（↑ 上传 / ↓ 下载）、阶段（接收/发送）、已传输字节、速率、已用时间**和最近完成记录，并可一键清空已完成；同时聚合服务器上的 `scp` / `rsync` / `sftp` 进程并解析其方向。传输页签每 2 秒单独轮询，不拖慢主快照。
- **点击查看详情**：点击任意条目打开右侧详情抽屉——测试显示 pytest 日志末尾，训练显示产物列表/指标/日志末尾，下载显示大小与解压明细，传输显示方向/阶段/速率/路径；详情里的路径可一键复制，行尾的复制图标仍可直接复制完整路径。
- 支持来源筛选（全部/本地/服务器）和名称/路径搜索；当前页签与来源会记住；服务端不可用时不影响本地数据。

远程数据通过 `dsh-ssh` 的 loopback exec 路由只读采集，不复制或存储 SSH 凭据；未安装 `dsh-ssh` 时插件仍可只展示本地工作区。

## 安装

1. 克隆仓库；
2. 在 DSH 插件管理页安装本目录，或使用 `plugin_manager install_bundle` 指向克隆目录的绝对路径；
3. 首次安装后重启 DSH。之后修改文件可以在插件管理页把 bundle 关一次再开，触发热重载，无需重启。

可选依赖：已安装并配置主机别名的 `dsh-ssh`（用于远程数据与 GPU）。

## 配置

在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的插件行里配置：

```yaml
config:
  localRoot: '/path/to/workspace'   # 要扫描的本地工作区
  remoteAlias: 'my-ssh-host'        # 主 dsh-ssh 主机别名；留空则只扫描本地
  remoteAliases:                    # 可选：额外的 GPU/主机监控目标（同样经 dsh-ssh）
    - 'gpu-host-2'
  remoteRoots:
    downloadRoot: '/data/downloads'
    trainingRoot: '/data/runs'
    logRoot: '/data/logs'
  refreshSeconds: 20                # 快照缓存时间
```

`remoteAlias` 同时是项目数据（下载/训练/测试/任务）的主机来源；`remoteAliases` 里的额外主机只聚合 GPU 与主机资源。可选键：`showLocal`、`showRemote`（布尔）。

仓库里的 `cordis.patch.yml` 只保留空配置；本机实际使用的路径、SSH 别名等建议写在 **profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`** 覆盖层（同 id 覆盖），这样仓库里不会出现个人路径。

## 接口

- `GET /api/dino-dashboard/state`：当前快照（过期则重建）
- `GET /api/dino-dashboard/transfers`：轻量传输状态（2 秒轮询，不触发 SSH 扫描）
- `GET /api/dino-dashboard/detail?source=local|remote&path=...&kind=...`：条目详情（本地读文件末尾/目录；远端经 dsh-ssh 读取）
- `POST /api/dino-dashboard/refresh`：强制重建

两个接口都只接受 loopback 请求，且只返回只读状态信息。

## 开发

```
package.json         # bundle patch + dsh.client（platform web）
cordis.patch.yml     # Host 行与配置
index.js             # Host：本地扫描、远程探测、路由
client.js            # Client：侧边栏入口与看板页面
locale/{zh,en}.json  # 插件管理页标题/描述
icon.svg             # 图标
```

安装后修改文件，重新安装或对 bundle 做一次「关→开」即可热重载。

plugins.description: Session trash for DeepSeek Harness: move sessions into a recycle bin with view/restore/permanent-delete · DSH 会话回收站
plugins.readme_text: # 🗑️ dsh-session-trash · 会话回收站 **DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 的会话回收站插件。** [English](#english) | 中文 把会话（含全部子会话）从侧边栏删进回收站，随时查看、还原或彻底删除。删除是**移动**：`sessions/`、`workspace.json`、`session_projcache` 三处零残留。 ## ✨ 功能 **🗑️ 删除** —— 会话行「⋯」菜单最底部的红字入口。行立即从侧边栏消失（广播宿主自带事件，不掉进「未分组」），3 秒内可撤销。 **♻️ 回收站**（设置 → 会话回收站）—— 每条三个操作： | 操作 | 行为 | |---|---| | 👁️ 查看会话 | 只读预览末尾 60 条消息 | | ↩️ 还原会话 | 原路移回、重新挂回工作区，标题立即恢复；删除前已归档的仍是已归档 | | 🔥 彻底删除 | 物理清除全部痕迹，两步确认 | **👻 幽灵会话扫描** —— 磁盘有痕迹、两边都不可见的会话，按不可见原因分三类： | 类别 | 含义 | |---|---| | 🫥 空白会话 | 0 条消息的空壳（blank 过滤永不显示） | | 🪃 孤儿会话 | 有内容但无归属：无记账，或父会话已删的 subagent | | 🏷️ 登记残留 | `workspace.json` / 投影缓存挂着 id，日志已不在 | **🛡️ 保护与隔离** —— 运行中的会话拒绝删除（点名）；回收站里的会话在侧边栏与搜索任何档位都不可见；插件停用即恢复，数据无损。 ## 📦 安装 ```bash dsh plugin --profile add dsh-session-trash # 本地开发： dsh plugin --profile add link:/绝对路径/dsh-session-trash ``` 要求 DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 及以上。 ## ⚠️ 已知边界 - **已加载会话需要一次重启收尾**：agent 在会话打开期间常驻（进程内不释放），其日志无法立即移动/删除。删除立即生效（列表消失），物理收尾由下次 DSH 启动自动完成，回收站行以「待收尾」/「待物理清除」徽标注明。 - 还原后会话回到工作区列表顶部，不是原位置。 - 附件（全局内容寻址存储）与 sqlite 全文索引（默认未启用）不在清理范围。 - 设置导航图标按文案匹配自己的行；与其他插件文案完全相同时可能错标（仅影响图标）。 ## 🔌 工作原理 单包双半边 bundle：host 由 `cordis.patch.yml` 挂载，browser 经 `dsh.client` 进入模块图；两端通过 `/session-trash/api/*` 通信（浏览器认证复用 `ctx.connection`）。 唯一的宿主方法补丁是 `sessionQuery.listSessions` 的可撤销过滤层。删除/还原/彻底删除全部走 `sessionPersistence`、`workspaceRegistry` 公开 API 与确定的磁盘路径规则（与 `dsh-session-persistence-jsonl` 的 `projectKey`/`encodeSegment` 逐字节一致，`test/parity.test.mjs` 对真实日志验证）。回收站索引在 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-session-trash/index.json`（原子写），记录每个成员的原始路径，还原精确原路移回。 🪶 **零依赖**：两个源文件，无 npm 依赖、无图标库（图标为手写内联 SVG / CSS mask）。 ## 🧪 测试 ```bash node test/parity.test.mjs ``` ## 📄 许可证 [MIT](LICENSE) --- ## 🗑️ English **Session trash for DeepSeek Harness.** Move sessions (with their whole subagent tree) from the sidebar into a recycle bin; view, restore, or permanently delete them, and scan for invisible leftovers. Deletion is a **move**: zero residue in `sessions/`, `workspace.json`, and `session_projcache`. ## ✨ Features **🗑️ Delete** — red entry at the bottom of the session-row "⋯" menu. The row leaves the sidebar instantly (stock host broadcast, no "Ungrouped" fallthrough); 3-second undo toast. **♻️ Trash** (Settings → Session Trash) — three actions per entry: | Action | Behavior | |---|---| | 👁️ View | Read-only preview of the last 60 messages | | ↩️ Restore | Moves logs back to their exact original paths, re-attaches accounting; title shows immediately, archived-before stays archived | | 🔥 Permanent delete | Purges every trace, double-confirm | **👻 Ghost scan** — sessions on disk but invisible on both sides, grouped by reason: | Kind | Meaning | |---|---| | 🫥 Blank | 0-message shells (never shown by the blank filter) | | 🪃 Orphan | Content but unaccounted, or a subagent whose parent was deleted | | 🏷️ Registry residue | Ids in `workspace.json`/projection cache with no log | **🛡️ Safety** — running sessions refuse deletion by name; trashed sessions are hidden from sidebar and search in every filter mode; disabling the plugin restores everything untouched. ## 📦 Install ```bash dsh plugin --profile add dsh-session-trash ``` DSH >= 0.2.1-rc.1. ## ⚠️ Known limits - **A still-loaded session needs one DSH restart to finish physically** — agents stay resident in-process; the trash row shows a pending badge and the startup sweep finishes automatically. - Restore places the session at the top of its workspace list, not its previous position. - Attachments and the (disabled-by-default) sqlite index are out of scope. - The settings-nav icon matches its row by label text; a plugin with the exact same label could mis-mark it (cosmetic only). ## 🔌 How it works The only host-method patch is a revocable `sessionQuery.listSessions` filter; everything else goes through public `sessionPersistence`/`workspaceRegistry` APIs and deterministic path rules verified byte-for-byte by `test/parity.test.mjs`. Trash index lives at `$DSH_HOME/dsh-session-trash/index.json` (atomic writes) and records each member's original path for exact restores. 🪶 **Zero dependencies**: two source files, no npm packages, hand-written inline icons. ## 🧪 Test ```bash node test/parity.test.mjs ``` ## 📄 License [MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Browser-native video and audio playback in the DSH right Sidebar, streamed over an authenticated HTTP Range route so a remote browser can play and seek large files without opening a native app on the Host.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-media-player

Play video and audio **inside the DSH right Sidebar** — including from a remote
browser, where the native **Open** button would otherwise launch QuickTime or
Music on the Host Mac.

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-media-player)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-media-player)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-media-player)](LICENSE)
[![node](https://img.shields.io/node/v/dsh-media-player)](package.json)

## The problem

DeepSeek Harness's document preview renders text, Markdown, code, images, PDF,
HTML, Office documents and spreadsheets. It has no audio or video renderer, and
`mp4`, `mp3`, `wav`, `flac`, `ogg`, `m4a`, `aac`, `wma` and `opus` are listed as
known binary containers with no viewer. Opening one shows:

> Preview is not available for this file type yet. **Open**

`Open` asks the **Host** to launch the file in a native application. On the
machine running the Host that is fine; from a phone, another laptop, or a
Tailscale peer it opens a window on a screen you are not looking at.

![Before: preview unavailable](docs/before.png)

## What this plugin does

It registers two document renderers, `video` and `audio`, and draws the
browser's native player in the preview pane. A companion Host route streams the
file with HTTP `Range`, so seeking works and a large video is never read into
memory or into the conversation.

| Video | Audio |
| --- | --- |
| ![Video preview over a remote URL](docs/video-preview.png) | ![Audio preview](docs/audio-preview.png) |

- **Native controls** — play/pause, seek, volume, fullscreen (video), and the
  browser's own picture-in-picture where available.
- **Seek without downloading everything** — `206 Partial Content` +
  `Content-Range`; the player asks for the bytes it needs.
- **Remote-browser ready** — the URL is document-relative, so the same preview
  works under `http://127.0.0.1:3080`, a LAN address, a Tailscale MagicDNS name,
  or `tailscale serve` on port 80. No configuration.
- **Download / open in a new tab** — both actions sit under the player.
- **Localized** — English and Simplified Chinese dictionaries.
- **Zero runtime dependencies** — one Host module and one browser bundle.

## Formats

| Kind | Suffixes |
| --- | --- |
| Video | `mp4` `m4v` `webm` `ogv` `mov` `mkv` `avi` `mpg` `mpeg` `3gp` `3g2` `ts` `m2ts` |
| Audio | `mp3` `m4a` `m4b` `aac` `wav` `flac` `ogg` `oga` `opus` `weba` `aiff` `aif` `wma` `mid` `midi` |

Playback is the browser's decision: Chromium plays H.264/AAC MP4, WebM, Ogg and
most audio, but usually cannot decode Matroska (`.mkv`) or AVI. When a codec is
unsupported the player shows an explicit message and the download link rather
than failing silently.

## Install

From npm:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-media-player
```

From a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/absolute/path/to/dsh-media-player
```

Current DSH web builds hot-mount the Host half; **refresh the page once** so the
browser bundle joins the module graph. If your build composes plugins only at
boot, restart `dsh web` instead.

Open any supported file from the Sidebar's **Files** tab. The preview pane shows
the player; the header still offers the native **Open** menu if you want it.

## Why a second file route?

DSH already has `GET /api/file`, and image and Markdown previews use it. It
answers the complete body with `200`, **ignores `Range`**, and caps at the
attachment image limit (20 MB by default). That is fine for an image and wrong
for a video: no seeking, and larger files are rejected with `413`.

`dsh-media-player` adds a sibling route instead of changing shared behavior:

| | `/api/file` | `/api/media` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Complete response | `200` | `200` |
| `Range` request | ignored (`200` full) | `206` + `Content-Range` |
| Seek | only after full download | immediately |
| Byte cap | ~20 MB | none beyond the filesystem |
| Reads | whole file buffered | 1 MiB chunks via `ctx.fs.readByteRange` |

Both routes live under `/api`, so the Connection carrier applies the Host/Origin
fence and browser-session cookie check before either handler runs.

## How it works

```
lib/index.js      Host: GET/HEAD /api/media, Range parsing, chunked streaming
lib/client.js     Browser: documentPreviews + sidebar.right.tab.document bodies
cordis.patch.yml  Bundle insert row
```

The browser half registers into `ctx.documentPreviews` with
`loading: 'renderer'` and declares each suffix binary, so the plain-text
fallback is not offered. The body reads
`useResource(resourceAddress).value.absolutePath` and builds
`api/media?path=…` relative to `document.baseURI`, then reports
`content.loaded(version)` once so the tab settles.

The Host half registers `ctx.connection.fetch.register({ path: '/api/media',
methods: ['GET', 'HEAD'] })`. A request is resolved through `ctx.fs`, so the
Host's file policy still applies, then `parseRange` turns `Range` into an
inclusive window. `416` carries `bytes */<size>`; `HEAD` returns headers only;
`download=1` adds an attachment `Content-Disposition`.

## Security

- The route is under `/api`, so it inherits the same authentication and
  Host/Origin fence as every other DSH API call. Unauthenticated requests get
  `401`; a foreign Host gets `403`.
- Only absolute paths are accepted. The route does not list directories and does
  not follow a path derived from user content without the filesystem provider's
  own resolution and access policy.
- Responses are `Cache-Control: private, no-store` and `X-Content-Type-Options:
  nosniff`.
- No telemetry, no network calls, no runtime dependencies.

## Verified

- A 59.6 s MP4 plays and seeks to 40 s over a Tailscale MagicDNS URL.
- A 28.6 MB MP4 is `413` on `/api/file` and `200` / `206` on `/api/media`.
- `Range: bytes=0-1023` returns `206`, `Content-Length: 1024`,
  `Content-Range: bytes 0-1023/<size>`.
- An unauthenticated request returns `401`; a `416` returns `bytes */<size>`.
- An MP3 loads metadata and seeks to 30 s.

## Compatibility

- DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` web composition, and later releases that keep
  `ctx.documentPreviews`, `sidebar.right.tab.document`,
  `ctx.connection.fetch`, and `ctx.fs.readByteRange`.
- Node 22+.
- Works in the DSH desktop app as well, because app-owned browser routes are
  document-relative.

## Scope

This plugin deliberately focuses on the **stock right Sidebar** and on making
media play from a **remote browser**. It does not add playlists, subtitle tracks,
playback-speed controls, or chat-inline media cards; other community plugins
cover some of those surfaces. The native player controls remain the authority for
playback behavior.

## Development

```sh
npm test        # node --test: range parsing and MIME mapping
```

There are no build steps. `lib/client.js` is a hand-written module-loader bundle
(`window.__ModuleLoader__.load`) whose only module requests are `react` and
`react/jsx-runtime`, so it uses the Host's React copy.

For an end-to-end check, run a DSH web instance with the plugin installed, open
a supported file, and confirm the `<video>`/`<audio>` element's `readyState`
reaches `4` and `currentTime` moves when you seek.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 Wilson Cheng

plugins.description: A permanent 'Delete session' action for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, behind a confirmation dialog.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-delete

A permanent **Delete session** action for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, behind a
confirmation dialog that tells you what is about to go.

DSH ships a *Archive* action, which is reversible and keeps the session in the
Archived list. This plugin adds the irreversible counterpart, and — unlike a
naive `rm` of the session log — it actually makes the row disappear.

## What it does

Adds one row to the per-session `…` menu in the left sidebar, ordered after
Pin / Rename / Fork / Archive. Choosing it opens a modal that reports:

- whether the session is **still open on this machine** (it cannot be reopened afterwards),
- the **log size** about to be removed,
- **running turns, subagents, background jobs and reminders** bound to the session,
- how many reminders are deleted with it.

Confirming stops the session's work, unlinks its session directory and projection
checkpoint, and releases the id from every registry that would otherwise keep
listing it. Then the sidebar refreshes and the row is gone.

There is **no undo and no trash folder**. The dialog says so.

## Why it is not just `rm`

A session's directory is not the only thing that makes it appear. The Host's
session corpus is `persistence ∪ live`, so a session the Host still holds live
keeps coming back after its log is deleted:

1. the browser drops the row,
2. the next `sessions.refresh()` rebuilds the rows from the Host list and folds
   the live summary back in,
3. the row **returns**.

The visible symptom of this is that deleting several sessions in a row makes the
earlier ones reappear, and that archived rows come back stuck in Archived forever
(the old id was never removed from the archive set, so it accumulated dead ids).

`release()` therefore detaches through the same teardown the owning fiber uses,
in the order the agent loop's own disposal uses — **agents first, then
sessions** — plus `unarchiveSession(id)` and `workspace.detachSession(id)`. The
browser keeps its own `retired` set and re-applies every retirement after each
refresh, so rows stay retired until the Host's `api-session/removed` agrees.

## Install

This package ships a `dsh.bundle` manifest, so `dsh plugin` installs it as a
profile layer by itself — **you do not need to edit `cordis.patch.yml`**. Bare
`@deepseek-ai/*` imports are resolved by the host itself, so the package declares
**zero dependencies** — do not add them.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add wilsonchengassistant/dsh-session-delete
```

`dsh plugin` is a pnpm passthrough, so from a clone the same spec works with a
`file:` path (`dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/dsh-session-delete`),
or you can clone and install by hand.

That command does two things: it adds the package as a dependency, **and** it
appends it to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile's `package.json`. The second
half is the one people miss — without it the package is just an unused
dependency, because the bundle patch in [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml)
is only read for packages the bundle list names.

Verify it joined the tree — the entry must appear under a banner naming the
plugin's own `cordis.patch.yml`, which is the part that is easy to miss:

```bash
dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config | grep -B1 session-delete
```

```
# == …/dsh-session-delete/cordis.patch.yml
- id: session-delete
  name: dsh-session-delete
```

A row under a banner for the *profile's* `cordis.patch.yml` means something
inserted this plugin by hand and it is **not** installed as a bundle — the
dependency is present but the layer never composes. `--dump-config` never
mounts, so it is safe against the live profile.

Finally **restart the harness**. The bundle is composed at boot, so there is no
partial effect: until it restarts, the menu row is not there.

### If nothing happens

- **Re-running the same add is a no-op** — same spec, same version.
  `rm -rf ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-session-delete` first, or
  the profile keeps serving the old copy forever.
- pnpm **copies** the package into the profile rather than symlinking it, so
  editing your clone does not change the running plugin. Copy
  `lib/*.js` into `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-session-delete/lib/`.
  `client.js` hot-reloads; `index.js` is host-side and needs a restart.
- `dsh plugin` needs `pnpm` on `PATH` (`corepack enable pnpm`), or it fails with
  "pnpm was not found".
- pnpm installs a version **older** than the registry `latest` when a release is
  less than 24 h old — that is `minimumReleaseAge`, a supply-chain guardrail, not
  a stale cache. Wait, or use a `^x.y.z` range so the newer release arrives on
  its own.

## Design notes

**A Typert `Remote` service, not an HTTP route.** The host half registers one
`TypertRemoteService` named `sessionDelete` with `describe` and `deleteSession`.
The Gateway auto-claims every endpoint a live `TypertRemoteService` declares, and
the browser calls it over the ordinary channel:

```js
ctx.connection.rpc.call('/api', `sessionDelete/${method}`, { args: { request } })
```

So there is no route to register and no permission to grant — the browser peer is
the owner principal.

**It deliberately does not check `Origin`.** In the desktop app the renderer
origin is the custom scheme `dsh-app://app`, and the shell's `protocol.handle`
strips `origin`, `host`, `cookie` and `sec-fetch-site` before forwarding to the
Host. A plugin route that validates `origin === 'http://' + host` therefore 403s
*every* request from the desktop app while working fine under `dsh web`. The
Remote-service path avoids the question entirely.

**The postcondition is checked against the disk.** A successful `rm` is not
treated as proof; `removeLog()` stats the path afterwards and throws
`delete/failed` if it survived.

## Files

| Path | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/index.js` | Host half: `TypertRemoteService`, the delete sequence, registry release. |
| `lib/client.js` | Browser half: the menu row and the `shell.overlay` confirmation dialog. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch named by `dsh.bundle`; inserts this plugin into a profile. |
| `locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json` | Plugin titles for the Plugins panel. |

The in-app dictionary lives in `lib/client.js` (`zh` is the key-set source of
truth, `en` is checked complete against it); `locale/*.json` is the metadata the
Plugins panel reads.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: Version browser for installed DeepSeek Harness plugins: list published versions, switch or roll back, and uninstall from the Plugins page.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-versions

Version browser for **DeepSeek Harness** plugins. It adds a **Versions** tab to the Web **Plugins** page where you can see every published version of an installed plugin, switch to one, roll back, or uninstall it — all through the host's own `pluginManager` service.

English | [中文](./README.zh.md)

## Why

The official plugin manager intentionally has no version picker: third-party plugins are upgraded by uninstalling and reinstalling, and only official on-demand bundles get an explicit **Update** button. Pinning a known-good version, or returning to one after a regression, means editing `package.json` by hand.

This plugin adds exactly that missing surface, without replacing the market or the installer.

## Features

- Lists the bundles the current profile installs, with version, source spec, and whether the bundle is removable
- Expands a bundle into its full published version list from the registry (publish date, `latest`, deprecated flags)
- Switches version through `pluginManager.removeBundle` → `pluginManager.installBundle`, saving an exact dependency
- **Automatic rollback**: if the target version fails to install (peer gate, missing version, network), the previous version is installed back and the failure is reported
- Uninstalls a profile bundle from the same tab
- Works with the profile's configured registry (private registries included) and falls back to `registry.npmjs.org`

## Install

The npm package is not published yet, so install straight from this repository:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:DangDangDeng/dsh-plugin-versions
```

or with an explicit Git URL:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add git+https://github.com/DangDangDeng/dsh-plugin-versions.git
```

In DSH Desktop the `desktop` profile is managed by the application, so use **Plugins → Add plugin** and enter `github:DangDangDeng/dsh-plugin-versions` instead of the CLI. Restart or refresh the page afterwards. Add `#<tag>` or `#<commit>` to pin a revision.

Once published to npm, `dsh plugin add dsh-plugin-versions` will work as well.

## Use

1. Open **Plugins** in the sidebar.
2. Select the **Versions** tab.
3. Expand a plugin to see its versions. The current one is tagged, and the newest is tagged `latest`.
4. **Switch** asks for confirmation, then removes and reinstalls the plugin at that version. A failure rolls back automatically.
5. **Uninstall** removes the bundle; its configuration is kept.

Refresh the page after a switch so the browser loads the other version's client half.

## How a switch works

```
pluginManager.listBundles()        find the installed bundle, remember its version
pluginManager.removeBundle(name)   unload + remove the dependency
pluginManager.installBundle(name@version, { saveExact: true, enabled: true })
   ├─ success → ChangeResult.application: applied | restart-required
   └─ failure → remove the half-installed package, install the previous version
```

`installBundle` refuses a package the profile already depends on (`already-installed`) in HMR profiles, which is why the removal is not optional. The host performs the same check before pnpm runs, so an incompatible peer range is reported without touching the profile.

## HTTP surface

The client half talks to the host half over one loopback-only route:

```
POST /plugin-versions/api/{list|versions|switch|remove}
```

Requests must carry `x-requested-with: XMLHttpRequest`, must not be `sec-fetch-site: cross-site`, and must arrive on a loopback `Host` (`127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, `::1`). Only bundles already installed in this profile can be switched or removed, so the route cannot be used as a general package installer.

## Limitations

- Loopback only: a page served with `--trusted-host` from another machine is refused.
- No automatic update check; this is a version browser, not an updater.
- Compatibility is not pre-checked per version — the host rejects an incompatible version and the switch rolls back.
- A switch needs `HMR` to apply live; without it the host reports `restart-required`.
- The page must be refreshed before the new version's client half runs.

## Development

Plain ESM, no build step:

```
index.js          host half: HTTP route + pluginManager calls
client.js         browser bundle: registers the Versions tab into plugins.tab
cordis.patch.yml  inserts the bundle row
locale/*.json     bundle title and description
```

Point the installer at this directory (`dsh plugin add <path>`, or **Add plugin** with an absolute path). The directory is linked, so edits take effect after a restart.

## License

MIT

# dsh-control-center

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Three visual Settings pages for the DeepSeek Harness: **MCP servers**, **skills**
and **global personas**. One dual-face plugin — a host half that owns the data
and the one model-facing contribution, and a browser half that renders the
pages into the settings shell.

> The Chinese document ([README.zh.md](README.zh.md)) is the fuller one: it adds
> the verification log, troubleshooting, and the one-click script reference.

```
Settings
├── …
├── MCP 管理          MCP server CRUD
├── Skill 管理        author or pull skills, inspect and delete them
└── 全局人设          a library of persona documents, one active
```

## Install

The package is a normal DSH bundle. Any channel works.

**One script (Windows).** Copies the package, backs the patch up once, and
writes the marked mount block — idempotent, `-DryRun` to preview, `-Profile` /
`-DshHome` to target another profile:

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\install.ps1
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\uninstall.ps1   # one-key restore
```

**Official CLI**, which also records the bundle in the profile manifest:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-control-center
```

**By hand**, for a profile whose `node_modules` is managed manually: copy this
directory to `<profile>/node_modules/dsh-control-center`, then append the mount
row to the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: control-center
      name: 'dsh-control-center'
```

`dsh-hmr` watches that file, so the plugin activates on save; the browser half
is part of the client boot graph and needs one page refresh the first time it
appears. After the first installation the script leaves
`cordis.patch.yml.bak-dsh-control-center` as the final rollback point.

## The three pages

### MCP 管理

An MCP server is a Loader row, not a settings value, so the page writes a
delimited **managed block** into the active profile's own patch layer and lets
`dsh-hmr` reload the composition:

```yaml
# >>> dsh-control-center:mcp — managed, edit it from Settings instead
- insert: [{"id":"cc-mcp-github","name":"@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client","config":{…}}]
# <<< dsh-control-center:mcp
```

Everything outside the two markers is preserved byte for byte, and the payload
is JSON — a strict subset of YAML 1.2 — so no URL, argument or environment value
can change the document's shape. The definitions live in
`$DSH_HOME/control-center/mcp-servers.json`; the block is regenerated from them
on every write, so disabling a server removes its row without losing it.

The row reports its live Loader state, so the list distinguishes *configured*,
*enabled* and *connected*.

### Skill 管理

Skills are ordinary files, so this page is a filesystem editor over the roots
`dsh-skill-filesystem` already scans — it keeps no database:

| Root | Source |
|---|---|
| `$DSH_HOME/skills` | `user-dsh`, provider rank 400 — where installs go |
| `$DSH_AGENTS_HOME/skills` | `user-agents`, rank 500 |
| any `customSkillDirs` | from a live `skill-filesystem` row |

Project roots (`.dsh/skills`, `.agents/skills`) depend on the session's working
directory rather than on this global page and are deliberately left out.

* **New skill** writes `<root>/<name>/SKILL.md` with `name`, `description`,
  `whenToUse` and the body.
* **Raw editor** opens the current file verbatim; saving re-validates the
  frontmatter.
* **Pull from GitHub** downloads one source archive, finds every `SKILL.md` at a
  plausible depth, and installs each bundle. Three URL shapes are accepted, plus
  the `git@github.com:owner/repo.git` spelling:

  ```
  https://github.com/owner/repo
  https://github.com/owner/repo/tree/<branch>
  https://github.com/owner/repo/tree/<branch>/<subpath>
  ```

  No `git` binary is needed: the archive is fetched from `codeload` and unpacked
  by a small built-in tar reader. An existing skill is only replaced when
  **overwrite** is on.

The filesystem provider watches its roots, so a created, edited or deleted skill
reaches the next model step without a restart.

### 全局人设

Each persona is a Markdown document under
`$DSH_HOME/control-center/personas/`, with its name and description in
`personas.json`. Exactly one is active, and the page can clear the seat.

The active document is registered as **one** system-prompt section:

```js
ctx.systemPrompt.section({
  name: 'control-center:persona',
  order: 5,
  text: activeDocument,
  interpolate: false,
})
```

Three properties follow, and all are intended:

* **additive** — the harness identity, the deployment persona, tool guidance and
  the environment suffix are untouched; the section lands immediately after the
  deployment persona prefix at order 0;
* **global** — a preset that shadows `deployment:persona-prefix` for one agent
  does not remove it, so every session is covered;
* **literal** — `interpolate: false` keeps `{{…}}` as written, so a stray brace
  in prose can never fail prompt assembly.

Switching the active document disposes and re-registers the section; the next
assembly carries the new text.

## HTTP API

One POST-only route, `/control-center/api`, with a `method` field:

| Method | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `system.info` | paths and version |
| `mcp.state` / `mcp.save` / `mcp.remove` / `mcp.toggle` | MCP servers |
| `skill.state` / `skill.read` / `skill.save` / `skill.write` / `skill.remove` / `skill.pull` | skills |
| `persona.state` / `persona.read` / `persona.save` / `persona.remove` / `persona.activate` | personas |

Responses are `{ ok: true, value }` or `{ ok: false, error: { code, message } }`.
The route is fenced against cross-origin browser callers: an `Origin` header must
name a loopback host, and a present `Content-Type` must be JSON. A caller with no
`Origin` — the Electron IPC bridge, a shell tool — is already running with the
user's own authority.

## Checks

Both scripts need no dependencies and no harness:

```bash
node scripts/selfcheck.mjs     # host half: frontmatter, tar, the managed block, all three stores over real files
node scripts/clientsmoke.mjs   # browser half: bundle, slot registration, every section rendered with stubbed host replies
```

`skill.pull`'s network path is not exercised by either; verify it against a real
repository from the running harness.

## Layout

```
index.js                 host half: route, API table, persona section, MCP reconciliation
client.js                browser half: the three Settings sections
lib/wire.js              body reader, JSON responder, request fence
lib/paths.js             DSH_HOME / profile locations, atomic read-write
lib/mcp.js               MCP store + the managed patch block
lib/skills.js            skill roots, frontmatter, CRUD, GitHub install
lib/github.js            repository reference parsing + archive download
lib/tar.js               minimal tar reader
lib/personas.js          persona store + the prompt section lifecycle
scripts/install.ps1      one-key install (UTF-8 with BOM — see README.zh.md)
scripts/uninstall.ps1    one-key restore
scripts/selfcheck.mjs    host-half checks
scripts/clientsmoke.mjs  browser-half checks
```

## Publishing to the DSH plugin market

`package.json` is already shaped for it (no `private`, `license`, `repository`
with `directory`, `keywords`, `engines.dsh`, `peerDependencies`,
`dsh.manifestVersion`) and `locale/{en,zh}.json` supplies the store card copy.

The catalog is the curated list [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin):
add ONE file under `data/plugins/`, run `node scripts/generate-readme.mjs`, open
a PR. The step-by-step checklist — plus the entry YAML, a pre-flight validator
and the screenshot template — lives in the repository's `publish/` directory.

plugins.description: Due-diligence document review for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic engine (documents → rule packs → risk report), evidence chain, docx/xlsx reports
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-dd-forge — due-diligence document review (DeepSeek Harness plugin)

English | [中文](./README.zh.md)

**Documents → rule packs → risk report**: feed the deterministic engine a due-diligence folder (registry / equity / financials / contracts / charters / employment contracts) and get a sourced risk report. Built for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/DeepSeek-AI/deepseek-harness); the engine (opcore) itself has zero dsh dependencies and runs standalone.

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ dsh session (model + judgement)                  │
│   skills: dsh-dd-forge-review / -report          │  ← judgement layer (prompt skills)
│   tools:  dd_review / dd_rules                   │  ← deterministic layer (registered tools)
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ opcore engine (engine/, zero dsh deps)           │
│   loader (docs → facts) → rule execution → report │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ packs/ (YAML rule packs — data, not code)        │
│   general-company 12 · contract-basics 8         │
│   trade-contract 8 · trade-bulk 10               │
│   logistics 8 · labour 8 · credit-financials 8   │
│   guarantee 5 · corporate-charter 5              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-dd-forge
```

Local development: `dsh plugin --profile <name> add /path/to/dsh-dd-forge` — pnpm `link:` installs do not auto-install dependencies, so run `npm install` in this directory first.

## Use

In a dsh session, hand a target folder to the model ("run a due-diligence review on ./target-company"), or call the tools directly:

- **`dd_review`** — run all rule packs over a folder (the `packs` parameter optionally narrows to a pack subset); returns findings and writes the report into the workspace (`reportPath` overrides the report location); the `format` parameter selects `md` / `docx` / `xlsx` (comma-separated, default `md`); the top-up loop parameters are `saveRun` (serialize this run into a re-runnable review.json snapshot) and `baseline` (diff against a previous snapshot — see "Top-up re-run loop"); pass a `targets` array to review several folders in one call (see "Batch review")
- **`dd_rules`** — list packs and every rule with severity, category, and public reference

Skills: `dsh-dd-forge-review` (folder conventions + verification discipline for high findings), `dsh-dd-forge-report` (writing the full DD report on top of engine output).

### Batch review (several folders)

To review several subjects in one session, `dd_review` takes a `targets` array (mutually exclusive with `target`): `targets=["./companyA","./companyB"]`. Each folder gets its own report set (exported per `format` as `<workspace>/dd-review-report-<company>.<ext>`; the folder name when no registry document names the subject; duplicates get `-2`/`-3` suffixes), plus one **summary index** at `<workspace>/dd-review-index.md` (`indexPath` overrides the location): a per-subject conclusion/stats table, a cross-subject high-severity quick view, totals, and relative links to every report — closed by the same disclaimer.

Every folder is validated up front (one inaccessible folder fails the whole call — no half delivery). `reportPath` / `saveRun` / `baseline` are single-run parameters and are rejected with `targets` — to take one folder through the top-up loop, call the tool with `target` for it alone.

### Folder conventions

The engine recognizes documents by filename patterns; anything missing simply leaves the corresponding rules as `missing_data`:

| Document | File | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Registry | `工商信息.json` (or any json matching 工商/registry) | Chinese or English keys; capital in 万元 |
| Equity | `*股权*.csv` or `.xlsx` (filename/sheet matching 股权/股东) | header: 股东,认缴出资(万元),实缴出资(万元),持股比例(%),备注 |
| Financials | `*资产负债*.csv`, `*利润*.csv`, `*现金流量*.csv` (or same-named xlsx sheets) | accounts as rows, years as columns (`科目,2024,2023`), 万元 |
| Contracts | `contracts/*.md` / `.txt` / `.docx` | one contract per file; optional frontmatter: 标题, 签订日期 |
| Charter | any `章程`-matching `.md` / `.txt` / `.docx` | extracts company name, registered capital, shareholder rows, mandatory items, share-transfer clause |
| Employment contract | any `.md` / `.txt` / `.docx` whose filename contains 「劳动合同」 or whose body contains 「劳动合同期限」 | extracts contract term, probation months and its statutory tiered cap, probation/agreed salary, non-compete term and compensation, service period with training cost and penalty, mandatory items and rules-policy wording |

docx (contracts/charters) and xlsx (financials/equity) are parsed **natively** (mammoth/exceljs, lazily loaded — zero cost when absent). Only scans/images need in-session conversion first.

The loader also extracts clause facts from contract bodies for the specialized packs: **deposit amount and ratio** ("定金…N 元"), **advance amount and ratio** (amount form "预付款 N 元" or percent form "预付 N%", feeding the bulk-trade pack), **payment term days** ("N 日内付清/支付" — deadlines that pay a deposit/advance do not count; read by both the trade and logistics packs), **daily penalty rate** ("万分之X/日", auto-annualized), **trade-contract classification** (购销/买卖/采购/销售/供货/大宗商品/贸易 — bulk-trade rules report 不适用 on non-trade contracts), **logistics-contract classification** (货物运输/运输服务/承运/仓储/配送 — logistics rules report 不适用 on non-logistics contracts; a counterparty *named* 「物流」 does not classify a contract), plus 36 clause-presence probes (risk transfer, force majeure, notice, acceptance, exclusivity, third-party inspection, price adjustment/点价, deposit-vs-penalty election, documents of title, auto-renewal, performance bond, settlement & invoicing, foreign-related & dispute institution, cargo damage liability, insured/declared-value carriage, loading duties, subcontracting restrictions, POD & reconciliation, cargo claims, vehicle & driver qualifications, …).

Employment contracts are parsed as their own document type (they never enter the commercial-contract candidate set): **contract term in years** (date form 「劳动合同期限自 X 起至 Y 止」 first, stated years as fallback; open-ended contracts detected separately), **probation months with the statutory tiered cap** (Labour Contract Law art. 19 tiers: <3 months 0 / 3 months-1 year 1 / 1-3 years 2 / ≥3 years & open-ended 6), **probation vs agreed salary** (auto-derived 80%-line ratio), **non-compete term** (months/years normalized) **and compensation clause** (an explicit 「无需支付经济补偿」 waiver does not count as agreed), **service period with training cost and penalty**, plus art.-17 mandatory-item and rules-policy probes.

## Rule packs

Nine packs, 72 rules, each with a public reference (statute or an explicitly labelled convention threshold):

| Pack | Rules | Coverage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `general-company` | 12 | registry status, paid-in ratio, equity cross-checks, balance-sheet identity & solvency, guarantee resolutions |
| `contract-basics` | 8 | essential clauses, digit-vs-uppercase amounts, signing date and signature block |
| `trade-contract` | 8 | deposit cap (Civ. Code art. 586, 20%), payment term (90-day convention), risk transfer, force majeure, daily penalty annualized |
| `trade-bulk` | 10 | bulk-trade special: advance ratio (30% convention), third-party inspection, price adjustment/点价, deposit-plus-penalty election (Civ. Code art. 588), force majeure excluding market swings, documents of title (仓单/提单), auto-renewal exit, performance bond, settlement & invoicing, foreign-related dispute institution |
| `logistics` | 8 | logistics special: cargo damage/loss liability (Civ. Code art. 832), insured/declared-value carriage, freight payment term (60-day convention reading the same fact as TC-002's 90-day line — layered thresholds), loading duties, subcontracting restrictions (cf. art. 923), POD & reconciliation, cargo-claim procedure & deadline, vehicle & driver qualifications |
| `labour` | 8 | employment special: mandatory clauses (Labour Contract Law art. 17), probation tiered cap and 80% salary line (arts. 19/20), non-compete compensation and two-year cap (arts. 23/24), servi
